meta.tagline: Raids, eggs & Team GO Rocket — CPs, shinies, and lineups at a glance.

callout.text: LIVE through Tue 27 Oct 10:00 PM local: Palkia 5★ + Mega Charizard X & Y. Standard 1★ now posted: Axew, Goomy, Jangmo-o, Frigibax. Standard 3★: Alolan Raichu, Alolan Ninetales, Alolan Muk (Leek Duck / GO Hub / ScrapedDuck). Palkia Raid Hour Wed 21 Oct 6–7 PM is OVER. Shadow Landorus (Incarnate) + Shadow 1★/3★ continue through 3 Nov. LIVE through Sat 24 Oct 11:59 PM: Minior Showers: Orionids (Green Core Minior; boosted 5–9 PM). Then Giratina (Origin) + Mega Sableye from 28 Oct (Mega Sableye through 8 Nov). Chandelure Super Mega Raid Day Sat 31 Oct 2–5 PM. Halloween 2026 Part I Tue 27 Oct.
callout.endsAtLabel: Palkia / Mega Charizard X+Y → Tue 27 Oct 10:00 PM · Orionids Minior → Sat 24 Oct 11:59 PM · Shadow Landorus → Tue 3 Nov 10:00 PM · Mega Sableye → Sun 8 Nov 10:00 PM · Chandelure SMRD Sat 31 Oct 2–5 PM
